title: 第153章 当年的缺口第152章 动手吧
lines: 第153章当年的缺口
曲灵没找回米丽她们，东西很多，她们正忙的脚不连地。
一直等到后半夜，卫桓沉着张脸走在前面，米丽和小火累的一脸菜色跟在后面，提着颗心，时不时瞄一眼卫桓。
相比于老板不高兴这件事，她俩累惨了这事，算不得事儿。
周局带着的九局，在百忙之中清了座帐蓬给盛夏她们，不过和坐在帐蓬里相比，盛夏更愿意坐在这片星光沉沉的夜幕之下。
周凯闲的不自在，进帐蓬给孙瀚帮忙去了，谈文累极了，拿了个睡袋出来，蜷在盛夏旁边，倒头就睡着了。
只有曲灵坐在盛夏旁边，有一搭没一搭的跟盛夏说话。
曲灵眼力非常好，远远看到卫桓过来，一窜而起，一句卫总回来了没交待完，人已经窜出去老远了。
现在卫桓是她的偶像，几乎可以和盛夏平齐的那种。
曲灵对力量的掌握很不怎么样，一窜窜过了，越过卫桓，直奔米丽和小火，窜过两只，一个急刹，转身跟上，被米丽狠瞪了一眼。
“你一直在这儿等着？累着没有？饿不饿？渴了没有？冷不冷？”卫桓看到盛夏，几步窜过去，侧身坐到盛夏旁边，关切道。
“都搬完了？”盛夏没答卫桓那一串儿的关切，一句话问到最后，看向米丽，这事儿问老米更靠谱些。
米丽点头，卫桓吐出口长气，“这么多年，头一回做这么琐碎的事儿。”
这个这么多年是多少年，他算不清了，也记不清了，好象有记忆以前，这是头一回，真是太繁琐太烦人了。
“卫总法力高深，一回都没错过。”小火陪笑拍了记马屁。
米丽看着抱着肩膀，有些寒瑟的盛夏，再皱眉仔细看着盛夏周围。
卫桓挥了挥手，米丽顿时舒了口气。
“你刚才让曲灵去找小米，有事儿？”卫桓接着问道。
“嗯，卡维家族一点善后的事儿。”盛夏答了句，转头看了眼还在沉睡的谈文，周凯也还没回来，“等一会儿再说吧。”
“好，让小米给你做点吃的，想吃什么？”卫桓听到卡维两个字，顿时不再放心上，一群血鬼，实在没什么值得放心上的。
“最好有个帐蓬。”米丽看着四周又要聚上来的阴影，斗胆建议道。
“有！那个就是，那个什么局给的帐蓬，我搭的，小夏说里面闷气。”曲灵忙指着旁边的帐蓬道。
“要是闷气就在这里。”卫桓又抬手挥了下。
“到帐蓬里吧，说话方便。”盛夏站起来，指了指沉睡的谈文，“小灵把谈文搬进去。”
没等盛夏再交待一句小心点，盛夏一把揪起谈文的睡袋，把谈文揪的一下子惊醒了。
几个进了帐蓬，谈文从睡袋里爬出来，米丽已经接收了一堆木炭烤炉各式食材，以及几大桶水，准备烤肉。
“你身上带什么法器了？”卫桓再挥了一次手之后，看着盛夏问道。
content_en:
Chapter 153 The Gap of the Year
Qu Ling didn't find Mili and the others. There were a lot of things and they were too busy to keep their feet on the ground.
Waiting until later in the night, Wei Huan walked in front with a solemn face, while Mili and Xiao Huo followed behind with tired expressions on their faces. They glanced at Wei Huan from time to time with their hearts high.
Compared to the fact that the boss is unhappy, the fact that they are exhausted is nothing.
The Nine Bureaus led by Zhou Bureau cleared a tent for Shengxia and the others in their busy schedule, but compared to sitting in the tent, Shengxia would rather sit under the starry night.
Zhou Kaixian felt uncomfortable and went into the tent to help Sun Han. He was very tired from Tan Wen, so he took out a sleeping bag, curled up next to Sheng Xia, and fell asleep.
Only Qu Ling sat next to Sheng Xia, talking to Sheng Xia at random.
Qu Ling had very good eyesight. When he saw Wei Huan coming from a distance, he jumped up. Before he could finish explaining that Mr. Wei was back, he was already far away.
Now Wei Huan is her idol, almost as good as Sheng Xia.
Qu Ling's mastery of power was not very good. He rushed past Wei Huan and went straight to Mi Li and Xiao Huo. He ran past the two of them, stopped suddenly, turned around to follow, and was glared at by Mi Li.
"Have you been waiting here? Are you tired? Are you hungry? Are you thirsty? Are you cold?" When Wei Huan saw Sheng Xia, he walked over in a few steps, sat sideways next to Sheng Xia, and asked with concern.
"Have you finished moving?" Shengxia did not answer Wei Huan's series of concerns. She asked at the end of the sentence and looked at Mi Li. It was more reliable to ask Lao Mi about this matter.
Mi Li nodded, and Wei Huan let out a long sigh, "This is the first time in so many years that I have done such a trivial thing."
He couldn't count or remember how many years it had been. It seemed like it was the first time before he could remember it. It was so tedious and annoying.
"Mr. Wei has great magic power and never misses a beat." Xiao Huo smiled and flattered him.
Millie looked at Shengxia who was holding her shoulders and feeling a little chilly, then frowned and looked around Shengxia carefully.
Wei Huan waved his hand, and Milly breathed a sigh of relief.
"You just asked Qu Ling to find Xiaomi. Is there anything wrong?" Wei Huan then asked.
"Well, it's about the aftermath of the Kawei family." Shengxia replied, turning to look at Tan Wen who was still sleeping. Zhou Kai hadn't come back yet, "Let's talk about it later."
"Okay, let Xiaomi make you something to eat. What do you want to eat?" When Wei Huan heard the word Kawei, he immediately stopped worrying about it. A group of vampires really had nothing to worry about.
"It's best to have a tent." Millie ventured to suggest as she looked at the shadows that were gathering around her.
"Yes! That's the tent given by some bureau. I built it. Xiaoxia said it was stuffy inside." Qu Ling hurriedly pointed to the tent next to him.
"If you are sulky, it's right here." Wei Huan raised his hand and waved again.
"Come to the tent, it's easier to talk." Shengxia stood up and pointed at Tan Wen, who was sleeping, "Xiao Ling, please move Tan Wen in."
Before Shengxia could tell him to be careful, Shengxia grabbed Tanwen's sleeping bag, causing Tanwen to wake up suddenly.
Several people entered the tent, Tanwen crawled out of the sleeping bag, and Mili had already received a pile of various ingredients for the charcoal grill and several large buckets of water to prepare the barbecue.
"What magic weapon do you have on you?" Wei Huan waved his hand again and looked at Shengxia and asked.
